summary: Optimization: Centralize and Parameterize API URLs

details.user_story: As a Developer, I want to centralize API URLs in a config file (Mobile) and Environment Variables (AI Service) so that I don't have to hunt down hardcoded strings when the backend URL changes.
details.context: We recently experienced a regression where App.js pointed to an old backend (vg35) while UploadService pointed to the new one (yalf).
acceptance_criteria: Mobile App reads API_URL and WS_URL from a single src/config.js file.
AI Service reads BACKEND_URL from os.environ, with a fallback default.
System functions identically to before (upload, overlay, progress bar).
technical_details: Refactor UploadService.js and App.js to import from config.js
